add_mask_rcnn_blobs: add Mask R-CNN specific blobs including mask_rois, roi_has_mask_int32, and masks_int32 to the input blob dictionary for training
expand_class_specific_masks: expand mask targets from shape (#masks, M**2) to (#masks, #classes * M**2) to encode class specific mask targets
build_mask_rcnn_minibatch: build a Mask R-CNN training minibatch by associating ground truth masks with foreground ROIs using polygon rasterization
review_add_mask_rcnn_blobs: review the add_mask_rcnn_blobs function to understand how it handles foreground and background ROI mask assignment
test_expand_class_specific_masks: test the _expand_to_class_specific_mask_targets function to verify mask expansion across class dimensions
